findings.entity: Market street aisle and background stalls
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:05, an open market street extends into the background behind the woman on the right side of the frame, with open sky above, buildings on the far right, and a man in a white polo shirt walking away down the aisle. At 00:06, with only a slight camera pan, the entire open street corridor and right-side buildings disappear and are replaced by a fruit stall counter (matching the green bin, plums, garlic, and tomatoes the woman already walked past on the left at 00:00-00:02).

At 00:07, to the left of the purple crate is a single column of a white two-tier wooden stand (green apples on top, avocados with a black sign on bottom), bordered immediately on its left by a low dark-green plastic bin of green fruit. After the woman walks across and occludes this area at 00:08, it emerges behind her back on the right at 00:09 with a different layout: the low green plastic bin has been replaced by a second white two-tier wooden stand holding green apples on top and bright red apples on the bottom.
